name: Shiori
message: "Mom used to send me to this supermarket on errands sometimes, but I don't really have any particular memories tied to it."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like the supermarket lady isn't here."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I was half-expecting her to bounce back and start chatting here again."

name: Shiori
message: "...I wonder if she disappeared. Or maybe she remembered she was dead, came back to her senses, and simply went home."

name: Shiori
message: "In the end, she couldn't be a good person, but she wasn't completely bad either."

name: Shiori
message: "It was probably because of her... and her gossip-loving friends too, that my family had to leave this town."

name: Shiori
message: "It's strange, but I don't really care that I was the one who took the fall."

name: Shiori
message: "But my dad, my mom, and my sister... I wonder how they felt before they moved away... It makes my heart ache."

name: Shiori
message: "I still can't say I forgive that lady, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "At the very least, I hope she was able to accept her death and pass on peacefully."

name: Shiori
message: "...I just realized something. Even when she was already cornered by Ms. Librarian and me, she never once apologized..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... whatever little sympathy I had left is now fading away... Maybe I really do lean more toward being a bad person..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I really can't bring myself to talk about anything pleasant here."

name: Shiori
message: "We should go somewhere else. I've had enough of this place."
